selection_rule: argmax of mean PR-AUC within each strategy sweep, re-run inside every resample
bias_correction: selection_bias = mean(resampled maxima) - mean(fixed winner resamples), isolating the winner's curse from the ordinary resampling bias; partial, does not substitute for a held-out selection split
quote_column: corrected_ci_lower/upper (the raw selection interval is stochastically above the naive one on the selection metric and is not a significance test)
